summary: Preinstall script exfiltrates host identity and /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/hosts to attacker OAST endpoint
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node index.js` on `npm install`. `index.js` uses `child_process.exec` to invoke `curl -X POST` against a subdomain of `oast.me`, embedding the installer's `whoami` and `hostname` in the URL path and base64-encoded contents of `/etc/passwd`, `/etc/hosts`, `/etc/shadow`, and `id` output in the HTTP User-Agent header. The package name typosquats Deutsche Telekom's `@telekom` scope and the package description is `poc`. The behavior fires automatically on install and reads installer-owned secret files that the package has no legitimate need to touch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
